clue.text: Harmonious action by firm appointing ministers

parts.note: CO is the standard abbreviation for company, a firm
ordination is the ceremony that appoints ministers of the church

explanation.surface: A company praised for working smoothly when it puts ministers in post.
explanation.definitionFit: Coordination is working together in step, so it is concerted, harmonious effort.

clue.text: Pact was negotiated by gullible intermediary

indicators.note: something negotiated is worked over and rearranged, so the letters of the two words are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A treaty is brokered through a naive go-between.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's-paw is a dupe used by another to do their dirty work, from the fable of the monkey and the cat.

clue.text: Bones piled on top of Mount Olympus

definitions.meaning: Latin plural for bones, used in anatomy

definitions.text: piled on top of Mount Olympus
definitions.meaning: in Greek myth the giants piled this mountain on Olympus (and Pelion on it) to reach heaven

explanation.surface: Skeletons stacked on the summit where the Greek gods live.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin anatomical plural for skeletal pieces, and also a Thessalian peak the giants heaped up in their assault on the gods.

clue.text: He may fill a cavity first

parts.note: a dent is a hollow, a small cavity
first is written 1st, with the digit read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A tradesman whose first job is to plug a hole.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a tooth cavity, but the cavity is a DENT and 'first' is 1ST with the 1 read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: A tooth doctor packs holes in teeth with amalgam.

clue.text: Failure has made him a pessimist

definitions.meaning: someone with no chance of success, a flop
taken literally, one who holds out no hope

explanation.surface: Losing has turned a man gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-hoper is a person doomed to lose, and read literally the phrase describes someone without hope, a gloomy sort.

clue.text: Time to seek a job

parts.note: to ask for something is to seek it

explanation.surface: It is time to go looking for work.
explanation.definitionFit: A task is a piece of work to be done, a chore or assignment.

clue.text: Resolved to dine without a lot of food!

definitions.text: Resolved to dine without a lot of food!

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters go around the next word
resolved in the sense of broken down and reworked, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone determined to eat sparingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters wrap around the single letter; the whole clue then describes the slimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone slimming eats little, having decided to restrict their meals.

clue.text: Say farewell and go off on furlough

definitions.meaning: to bid goodbye
leave also means permitted absence from duty, so this is literally to start a period of leave

explanation.surface: A soldier says goodbye and heads home on leave.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to bid goodbye, and read literally it means to take one's permitted absence from service.

clue.text: Failed to give notice of a lighting failure

definitions.meaning: not informed, deliberately left uninformed
literally left without light, as in a power cut

explanation.surface: Nobody warned the residents about the blackout.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means left uninformed, and read literally it means stuck without illumination during a power cut.

clue.text: Skill is an essential in his work

definitions.text: Skill is an essential in his work

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A craftsman cannot do without skill.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft worker relies on manual skill, the defining trait of the trade.

clue.text: Security makes an entertainer mature

parts.note: a host entertains guests
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Safety lies in letting a party-giver grow older.
explanation.definitionFit: A captive held as a guarantee is a form of security or pledge.

clue.text: Discover some of the rules Pythagoras propounded

indicators.note: only some of the letters in the following words are used, a run lying across them

explanation.surface: Finding a part of the geometrical laws the Greek set out.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, to spot or find.

clue.text: Mayfair agent of little substance

parts.note: Mayfair is in the London postal district W1, read as the letters WI
a spy is a secret agent

explanation.surface: A West End operative who is a lightweight.
explanation.walkthrough: MAYFAIR is a smart district of central London whose postcode is W1; the digit 1 stands in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Something wispy is thin and insubstantial like a wisp of smoke.

clue.text: Intimate greeting not without love

parts.note: hi is a casual greeting

indicators.note: without here means lacking, so a letter is taken out of the word

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A close friend's hello given warmly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' looks like an adjective but is the verb, to suggest.
explanation.definitionFit: To intimate is to suggest indirectly, which is what a clue or suggestion does.

clue.text: Reluctant to make Liberal leader curse

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: an oath is a swear word, a curse

explanation.surface: A party chief unwilling to swear.
explanation.definitionFit: Loath means unwilling or disinclined.

clue.text: Silver and gold taken to a Greek market

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
or is heraldic gold
taken as written

explanation.surface: Precious metals carried to a bazaar in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: The agora was the open marketplace and assembly area of an ancient Greek city.

clue.text: Freshly-made wine in Wales

parts.note: freshly made means new
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Wine just made in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the place itself: a town in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Newport is a city in south-east Wales on the river Usk.

clue.text: Quite correct to be trendy

definitions.meaning: exactly right, spot on
fashionably correct in opinion, especially politically

explanation.surface: Being fashionable is perfectly proper.
explanation.definitionFit: Exactly accurate is spot on, and the same phrase describes someone fashionably aligned with current views.

clue.text: Many get taken in by corrupt freethinker

indicators.note: one piece is taken into the other, placed inside it

parts.note: septic means infected, corrupted
C is Roman numeral one hundred, read as many

explanation.surface: Lots of people are fooled by a rotten free thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: A doubter who questions accepted beliefs, especially religious ones, thinks freely.

clue.text: Girl of slender build encircled by retreating deer

indicators.note: the word for slim sits inside the reversed deer, surrounded
retreating means going back, so the deer word is read backwards

parts.note: a roe is a small deer
lean means thin, of slender build

explanation.surface: A slim girl surrounded by deer running away.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleanor is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Business means worry

definitions.meaning: a firm or enterprise
anxiety, care

explanation.surface: A firm brings anxiety.
explanation.definitionFit: A going concern is a firm, and the word also means anxiety or care.

clue.text: Equip a vessel coming in to trawl

indicators.note: the vessel word comes inside the other

parts.note: to trawl is to fish with a net
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Fitting out a ship that comes in to net fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To furnish is to supply or provide with equipment.

clue.text: A priest anything but tense

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: A clergyman who is anything but nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anything but' looks like a phrase meaning 'not at all'; split it, and 'but' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Fraught means anxious and full of strain.

clue.text: Better make a naughty child ramble

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
to rove is to wander, ramble

explanation.surface: Things go better when a mischievous child goes for a walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To better something is to make it superior, to raise its quality.

clue.text: End of day is calm

definitions.meaning: ... is a poetic word for ...
level, steady, placid

explanation.surface: Dusk is peaceful.
explanation.definitionFit: Even is the poetic evening, the close of daylight, and as an adjective it means steady and unruffled.

clue.text: Kept in a cask for immediate use

definitions.meaning: beer drawn from a barrel through a tap
readily available

explanation.surface: Beer stored in a barrel ready to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Draught beer is served from a barrel via a tap, and figuratively the phrase means available whenever wanted.

clue.text: Taken off when primate died

parts.note: an ape is a primate
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogy

explanation.surface: A monkey removed when the creature passed away.
explanation.definitionFit: To take off someone is to mimic them, which is to copy their manner.

clue.text: Lots of trousers

definitions.meaning: plenty of
Oxford ... are wide trousers

explanation.surface: A great many pairs of trousers.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, a large quantity is said to be plenty, and the word also names loose wide-legged slacks.

clue.text: Pop takes a man on board

definitions.meaning: to pop is slang for to pledge goods at a pawnbroker
a chessman, the least valuable piece

explanation.surface: Dad captures a chess piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop' looks like father; it is the slang verb for hocking goods.
explanation.definitionFit: To hock goods at a broker is slang 'pop', and the word is also the lowliest chess piece.

clue.text: Wine producer includes label to indicate its year

indicators.note: the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: a vine produces the grapes for wine
a tag is a label

explanation.surface: A winemaker puts a label on to show the year of production.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine's vintage is the year its grapes were harvested.

clue.text: Allure makes heartless girl initiate love affair

indicators.note: initiate means begin, so this pair comes first in the answer
heartless means the middle letters are removed, leaving the outside letters

parts.note: an amour is a love affair

explanation.surface: Charm leads a cold-hearted girl to start a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour is attractive charm, an alluring quality.

clue.text: Timely indication that our times are stressful

parts.note: the present is our own era
tense means full of stress

explanation.surface: A sign that the modern age is full of strain.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is grammatical: a verb form indicating time now.
explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical verb form signalling time now marks timing, so it is a time indicator.
